propositions: when tool_step_limit cutoff is reached after tool calls have occurred, pydantic-ai omits toolConfig from requests while message history contains toolUse blocks, causing Bedrock/Anthropic to reject with ValidationException 400
the current mechanism of hiding tools via .filtered() violates the provider protocol constraint that toolConfig must be defined when history contains tool_use or toolResult blocks
tool_step_limit should transition to a steering-based mechanism using WrapperToolset that returns synthetic results instead of hiding tool definitions, keeping tools advertised for protocol validity
evidence/bounded-recovery runs with tool_step_limit=16 fail with the same 400 error if reaching step 17, blocking the fallback recovery path
unit tests using FunctionModel miss the provider constraint because FunctionModel accepts tools-less requests over tool_use history, whereas real providers reject this
a model that ignores steering results must still be terminally bounded by existing UsageLimits (request_limit, tool_calls_limit) to prevent infinite loops
